actual_coverage.requested_week: October 1-8, 2026; WNGSR release and retrieval occurred October 8, with underlying gas observation through October 2.
actual_coverage.gas: Lower-48 and five storage regions; week ending October 2; October 8 release; current/prior/year-ago/five-year cells plus sampling variability.
actual_coverage.petroleum: Twelve US series, 3,420 verified bridge rows through September 4; current-vintage histories first observed September 14; no duplicate collection.
actual_coverage.electricity: Reused July 2025/2026 US sector sales and January-July sensitivity from the September 24 EPM release.

limitations: US-only and unevenly lagged coverage; the gas observation is current to October 2, electricity to July and petroleum to September 4.
Storage is not consumption; no matched weather, production, pipeline-flow or price controls were executed.
Petroleum is one reused EIA family and current-vintage history, not fresh evidence or a historical release-vintage archive.
Electricity sales are preliminary monthly billing quantities, not hourly load or total industrial energy use.
Tool-extract integrity does not establish original publisher-body identity or hidden upstream request/byte/redirect totals.
Exploratory analysis with prior exposure; no calibrated probability, causal model, market-return forecast or trade recommendation.
